command:
$testName = 'mdview-release-e2e-1795197747604'

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$temp = [IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
$root = Join-Path $temp "$testName-final"
$verify = (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $root 'verify-installed')).FullName
$exe = 'C:\path\mdview.exe'
$id = (Get-Content -LiteralPath "$exe.version" -Raw).Trim()
$doc = Join-Path $verify 'installed.md'
$inputFile = Join-Path $verify 'input.json'
$stdout = Join-Path $verify 'stdout.txt'
$stderr = Join-Path $verify 'stderr.txt'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($doc, '# Installed mdview')
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($inputFile, (@{File=$doc; Visible=$false} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
$env:TEMP = $verify
$env:TMP = $verify
$env:APPDATA = Join-Path $verify 'roaming'
$env:LOCALAPPDATA = Join-Path $verify 'local'
$env:MDVIEW_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $verify 'config'
$viewer = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList "--resume=$id" -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardInput $inputFile -RedirectStandardOutput $stdout -RedirectStandardError $stderr -PassThru
try {
    if (-not $viewer.WaitForExit(20000)) {
        $viewer.Kill()
        [void]$viewer.WaitForExit(3000)
        throw 'Installed viewer did not finish its startup check'
    }
    $reply = Get-Content -LiteralPath $stdout -Raw
    if ($viewer.ExitCode -ne 0 -or -not $reply -or $reply.Trim() -ne 'ready') {
        $details = Get-Content -LiteralPath $stderr -Raw
        throw "Installed viewer failed its startup check: $details"
    }
    Write-Output "Installed executable opened a document and confirmed release $id"
    Get-Item -LiteralPath $exe | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime
} finally {
    $viewer.Dispose()
}
$env:TEMP = $temp
$env:TMP = $temp
foreach ($name in @($testName, "$testName-final")) {
    $expected = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $temp $name))
    $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $expected -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($dir -and $dir.FullName -eq $expected -and -not ($dir.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
